MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Partners and Emerald feel like natural next choices because polished, melodic singing connects with what I enjoyed in Stages and Lead With Your Heart.",
    "Dark Sky Island fits the calm, atmospheric listening I want now, which connects with my latest choice of relaxing classical music."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Christmas albums offer appealing voices and harmonies, but I am not seeking seasonal music right now.",
    "Hamilton connects with my interest in musical theatre, but its rhythm-driven energy does not fit today's gentler mood. How Can It Be offers a devotional focus I have not sought out.",
    "25 and Windy City give me less reason to choose them than music with a clear connection to soothing sounds or polished theatrical vocals."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My earlier Christmas listening seems to have been taken as an ongoing desire for more holiday albums.",
    "Enjoying vocal performances and musical theatre seems to have been stretched into interest in recordings with quite different energy and subject matter."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent relaxing classical selection matters because I currently want calm listening, even when the music includes vocals.",
    "Expressive, melodic singing matters more to me than simply having a singer or a connection to the stage."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The choices capture my interest in polished vocals but give too little weight to my current preference for calm, nonseasonal listening."
}
